label: b43: BBF-style shrink-and-perturb resets, the reset alone (row D1) on b40's M-QR-DQN N 32 cell, alpha 0.5, stop after 10.5M gradient steps, 3M steps; every 600k gradient steps beside every 2.4M, every 2.4M, seed 6 of 8
notes: Batch b43: row D1 of the algorithm series, BBF-style shrink-and-perturb resets -- the reset alone, not BBF and not a test of its data efficiency; a negative here waits for the anneal wave before the row closes -- (Schwarzer et al. 2023, section 4) as the late-plasticity probe on b40's M-QR-DQN cell (plans/algoExploration/d-data-efficiency.md, re-planned 2026-09-20). The base is b40e-h's spec verbatim -- QR-DQN N 32, kappa 1, Munchausen alpha 0.9 tau 0.03 l0 -1, the local DQN plumbing (fork 4, shield, PER, target every 8, replay ratio 1, batch 128, lr 1e-5), hist8, fc 320, 3M counted steps -- plus three knobs: every SNEK_RESET_INTERVAL gradient steps the trunk (every hidden linear) is pulled halfway to a fresh initialisation (SNEK_RESET_ALPHA 0.5), the quantile head is re-initialised, the target copied and Adam's state cleared; no reset after gradient step 10.5M (SNEK_RESET_STOP_AFTER), the last eighth reset-free as the paper keeps it. The cell runs about 4 gradient steps a counted step, so 3M steps is about 12M gradient steps. reset600k (b43a-d): every 600k gradient steps, about 20 cycles, the paper's count. reset2400k (b43e-h): every 2.4M, about 5 cycles. Nothing else of BBF comes with it: the wider net, replay ratio 8, AdamW, the EMA target, SPR and the 100k regime are data-efficiency levers, and on an exact in-process simulator the scarce resource is gradient steps, not moves. The within-cycle n-step and gamma anneal is a second wave (SNEK_RESET_ANNEAL_*, not built) if the reset cells show the relearning dip but not the hold. Why: every Group A cell reached 88-94% and then drifted or never held, and b40 closed 2026-09-20 with the value target ruled out as the ceiling (M-QR-DQN 89-93 after onset, 436 stage-B rows, best 98.0, no hof5000 candidate); late drift is the shape of most of this project's collapses and the reset is a late-plasticity mechanism. Read against b40e-h, the same cell without resets, on the hold: the perfect rate after each reset's dip and in the reset-free tail, drawdown count, zero_since; then stage B, hof5000, hof30k. Gates (2026-09-20): smoke with resets every 1,000 gradient steps checkpoints, restores and resumes with the reset count; tests/mut_resets.json 10 of 10; the suite passes with the knob at 0; b40 closed. Prediction (agent, from the plan): the 600k cell shows a visible dip after each reset and a higher late perfect rate than b40e-h's (89-93 after onset, 0-3% below 80); the 2.4M cell shows fewer, deeper dips. If neither holds better than b40e-h the reset is not the lever here and Group D closes as a null. Unpinned; either box claims waves of 4.
